subject: Urgent: allocation tension — Kestrel & Lumen dedicated commits overlap
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Park <danielle@kestrel.ai>, Lumen Procurement <procurement@lumencloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: allocation tension — Kestrel & Lumen dedicated commits overlap

Danielle / Alex,

Quick heads-up — while validating Q3 slot assignments against signed commitments we found an overlap window where both Kestrel (DEAL-9831) and Lumen (DEAL-9988) have reserved A100 capacity that exceeds available tranche capacity on our Aurora pool for 2027-07-01 through 2027-08-15.

Numbers at a glance (summary):
- Aurora tranche available: 96 x A100-80GB-equivalent GPU-hours/mo (after existing tenant reservations)
- Kestrel reserved request: 48 x A100 equiv (go-live target 2027-07-05)
- Lumen reserved request: 64 x A100 equiv (SLA-backed commit, go-live target 2027-07-20)

We need to resolve how to honor SLA commitments without blocking Kestrel's onboarding. Proposed short list of options we can take immediately:
1) Short-term cede: Lumen voluntarily cedes up to 10 A100 equivalents for 6 weeks while we provision burst or shift workloads (requires procurement sign-off).
2) Temporal shift: Move Kestrel onboarding to 2027-07-12 with a firm slot guarantee and a one-time credit.
3) Burst capacity: Use Reserved Burst pool (costly) to cover Kestrel's first 3 weeks while we re-balance (requires finance sign-off).

I'm looping capacity and sales ops so we can evaluate which path meets both customers' expectations. Ben / Karthik / Laura — can you confirm what guardrails we need (SLA, credits, technical work to remap)? I attached the Q3 capacity plan for context.

Danielle, I understand Kestrel has a hard go-live preference in early July — if you can share which pipelines are most latency-sensitive we can prioritize mapping to lower-latency servers.

Short call today at 11:00 PT to align? If not, earliest possible times tomorrow.

Attachments: capacity_plan_q3.xlsx

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Capacity Planner | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Danielle Park <danielle@kestrel.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: allocation tension — Kestrel & Lumen dedicated commits overlap

Chloe —

Thanks for flagging. We do have a hard dependency on starting internal beta 2027-07-06 (customer pilot the following week). Delaying to mid-July would break our customer milestone and could push revenue recognition.

If temporary burst is the only path, we need a firm written guarantee that we get the reserved baseline (48 A100 equiv) by 2027-07-20 at the latest. We also have an executed term sheet — attaching the signed copy for reference.

Options ranked from our side: 1) Burst + firm handoff plan, 2) Lumen cedes 10–12 GPUs for 6 weeks, 3) Kestrel shift (least preferred).

Available for a quick call at 11:00 PT.

Attachment: kestrel_signed_term_sheet.pdf

—Danielle
Danielle Park
Head of Platforms | Kestrel AI
danielle@kestrel.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: allocation tension — Kestrel & Lumen dedicated commits overlap

Team —

Recap from my side after reviewing commitments and SLA tiers: Lumen has an enterprise SLA clause that requires us to maintain >=95% availability on reserved throughput; their billing and support tier make preemption expensive (credits + potential churn risk). Kestrel is early revenue but time-sensitive for launch.

My recommended mitigation (operational + commercial mix):
- Hold Lumen baseline: retain 80% of Lumen's reserved baseline (51/64 A100 equiv).
- Short-term re-balance: reassign 13 A100 equiv from Lumen to Kestrel for 6 weeks, covered by a one-time credit to Lumen (credit amount TBD by finance).
- Burst coverage: provide a 3-week burst overlay for Kestrel (paid at burst rate) to smooth first-week traffic spikes.
- Guarantee firm handoff: commit to provisioning the remaining 35% of Kestrel baseline by 2027-07-20 max — if we miss that milestone, provide Kestrel a service credit and prioritized queue for the next slot.

Operational tasks (owners):
- Ben: draft commercial note to Lumen procurement with proposed credit amount and timeline.
- Karthik: model cost delta for burst + credit and get finance estimate.
- Laura: create the deployment mapping to ensure Kestrel pipelines land on lower-latency hardware.
- Chloe: schedule go/no-go checkpoints (2027-07-01 and 2027-07-12).

I attached a quick allocation_decision_matrix that I used to pick the above. We need executive sign-off (VP of Sales / Head of Finance) on the credit before committing to Lumen.

Attachment: allocation_decision_matrix.pdf

Marissa Cole
VP, Capacity & Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Danielle Park <danielle@kestrel.ai>, Lumen Procurement <procurement@lumencloud.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Decision summary — Kestrel/Lumen allocation (action items)

Thanks all for the quick turnaround. Confirming the agreed path and next steps so we have a single source of truth for external comms. Please reply with minimal "ack"/"confirm" if you agree.

Decision (agreed internally pending Lumen sign-off on commercial credit):
- Lumen retains 51 A100 equiv baseline.
- Lumen cedes 13 A100 equiv to Kestrel for 6 weeks (2027-07-05 -> 2027-08-16).
- Kestrel receives a paid 3-week burst overlay to handle initial pilot traffic; formal handoff of reserved baseline by 2027-07-20.
- If handoff misses the 2027-07-20 date, Kestrel receives a pro-rated service credit and priority remapping.

Immediate action items: 
- Ben: send procurement proposal to procurement@lumencloud.com with credit figure and ask for written cede by EOD Thu 2027-06-17.
- Karthik: provide the finance delta and confirm budget impact by Thu 2027-06-17.
- Laura: prepare deployment mapping and a validation run (test tokens) by 2027-07-01.
- Chloe: prepare external note to Kestrel with firm timelines and what to expect during burst weeks.

I'll prepare a short external email once Ben confirms Lumen's verbal acceptance.

Chloe Martin
Capacity Planner | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
